0022600211.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-9) visit the New York Knicks (5-4) for the Bucks' 11th game of the season, with Milwaukee on a six-game losing streak, 0-4 on the road, and fifth in the Central, 5.5 games back. New York, third in the Atlantic and fifth in the East, has won three straight, and Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The Bucks are also without Tyler Herro (knee bruise) and Gary Trent Jr. (illness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not played this season after Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 127-98 loss in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
